submit an application: If you want to join the summer program, you must submit an application to the office before May 1.
如果你想參加暑期課程，必須在五月一日前向辦公室提交申請。
submit to authority: Some teenagers refuse to submit to authority and argue with every rule their parents and teachers make.
有些青少年拒絕服從權威，對父母和老師訂的每條規定都要爭論。
submit a report: Each group has to submit a report on the field trip to Ms. Chen by next Monday.
每組都必須在下週一前交一份校外教學報告給陳老師。
submit to treatment: Although he was afraid of hospitals, the old man finally agreed to submit to treatment for his heart problem.
雖然害怕醫院，那位老先生終於同意接受心臟問題的治療。
submit a bid: Five building companies plan to submit a bid for the new stadium project, hoping to win the contract.
五家建設公司打算為新體育館工程投標，希望能拿下合約。
refuse to submit: Even though the enemy surrounded their town, the brave villagers continued to refuse to submit to the invaders.
即使敵軍包圍了城鎮，勇敢的村民仍然拒絕向侵略者屈服。
substitute for sugar: My mom uses honey to substitute for sugar when she bakes cakes, because she thinks it is healthier.
我媽媽烤蛋糕時用蜂蜜代替糖，因為她認為那比較健康。
substitute A for B: If you don't have butter, you can substitute olive oil for butter in this recipe, and it still tastes great.
如果沒有奶油，這道食譜可以用橄欖油取代奶油，味道依然很棒。
no substitute for experience: Reading books about driving is helpful, but there is no substitute for experience on real roads.
讀關於開車的書有幫助，但實際上路的經驗是無可取代的。
a substitute teacher: Our English teacher was sick today, so a substitute teacher came to give us a short quiz.
我們的英文老師今天生病，所以一位代課老師來幫我們小考。
come on as a substitute: The young player had to come on as a substitute in the second half, and he scored the winning goal.
這位年輕球員在下半場替補上場，並踢進了致勝的一球。
subtract 3 from 10: My little brother is learning math; when you subtract 3 from 10, he counts on his fingers to get seven.
我弟弟正在學數學；十減三時，他會扳手指數出七。
subtract from the pleasure: The noisy crowd and long lines did subtract from the pleasure of our visit to the famous museum.
吵雜的人群和大排長龍的確減損了我們參觀那間著名博物館的樂趣。
subtract the cost: If you subtract the cost of materials from the price, the profit on each cake is only fifty dollars.
如果從售價中扣除材料成本，每個蛋糕的利潤只有五十元。
succeed in business: To succeed in business, you need not only good ideas but also hard work and patience.
要在事業上成功，你不只需要好點子，還需要努力和耐心。
succeed to the throne: When the old king died, his eldest son was the first in line to succeed to the throne.
老國王去世時，他的長子是繼承王位的第一順位。
succeed one's father: After graduating from college, Jason returned home to succeed his father as the manager of the family restaurant.
大學畢業後，傑森回家接替父親擔任家族餐廳的經理。
succeed in doing: After three years of hard work, Lily finally managed to succeed in passing the difficult exam.
經過三年努力，莉莉終於成功做到通過那場困難的考試。
nothing succeeds like success: After their first hit song, the band won more fans and more offers; nothing succeeds like success.
在第一首暢銷歌之後，樂團贏得更多歌迷與邀約；真是一事成功萬事順。
suck someone in: Online games are designed to suck someone in, so a player who plans to play for ten minutes often plays for hours.
線上遊戲的設計就是要把人捲入，所以原本打算玩十分鐘的玩家常常一玩就好幾個小時。
be sucked into a conflict: I tried to stay neutral, but I was sucked into a conflict between my two best friends.
我試著保持中立，卻還是捲入了我兩個最好朋友之間的衝突。
suck up to the boss: Nobody likes Peter at the office because he always tries to suck up to the boss instead of doing his job.
辦公室裡沒人喜歡彼得，因為他總是拍老闆馬屁，而不好好做事。
it sucks: We have a big test on my birthday, and it sucks, but I still have to study tonight.
我生日那天有大考，糟透了，但今晚我還是得唸書。
suck the life out of: Working twelve hours a day at a boring job can suck the life out of even the most cheerful person.
每天在無聊的工作上做十二小時，連最開朗的人也會被榨乾活力。
suck up resources: The huge new airport project will suck up resources that could have been used for schools and hospitals.
這項龐大的新機場工程會吸走原本可以用在學校和醫院上的資源。
sue for damages: After the accident, the injured driver decided to sue the bus company for damages to cover his hospital bills.
事故後，受傷的駕駛決定向公車公司訴請賠償，以支付醫藥費。
sue for peace: After losing three major battles, the weakened king was forced to sue for peace with his enemy.
連輸三場重大戰役後，衰弱的國王被迫向敵人求和。
sue a company: If a product hurts you because it was badly made, you have the right to sue a company for its mistake.
如果產品因製造不良而傷害你，你有權為了它的錯誤控告公司。
threaten to sue: When the newspaper printed false stories about him, the actor began to threaten to sue unless it apologized.
當報紙刊登關於他的不實報導時，這名演員開始威脅提告，除非報社道歉。
sue for divorce: After years of unhappy marriage, she finally went to a lawyer to sue for divorce from her husband.
經過多年不幸福的婚姻，她終於去找律師訴請與丈夫離婚。
